text:
Marta: Heads-up 1 1 Aurora Diagnostics (AD-310) submitted SR-9612. Sales committed '50% off months 1-2' in an email on 2026-09-02 but only month 1 was discounted. Customer asking for retro credit of $5,700 across invoices AD-2026-09-15 and AD-2026-10-15. Can finance approve?

Noah: Checked CRM and invoice lines. Invoice AD-2026-09-15 shows 50% applied; AD-2026-10-15 billed at full list. Total invoice amount for Oct = $11,400; expected 50% would be $5,700 credit. Sales Ops: AE says this was an operational miss.

Carlos: Policy note 1 credits > $5k need Deal Desk + Finance lead sign-off. This is $5,700 so escalate. Also need GL code and memo wording. Is there churn risk?

Marta: CS indicates medium risk 1 customer paused evals until resolved. Support ticket has AE email chain.

Jamal: Sales Ops confirms commitment but no Deal Desk entry. Recommend honoring as one-time commercial concession and classify under GL 6510 (Customer Discounts). I'll open DD-2026-881 and attach evidence.

Carlos: Approve DD-2026-881 provisionally for $5,700. Approver note: one-time onboarding honor per AE email; classify GL=6510; no master contract amendment. Require BillingBot to queue CM-2026-09-99 and Sales to notify customer copy.

Marta: Draft customer note: "We've issued a one-time retroactive credit of $5,700 to reflect the agreed onboarding discount for months 1-2. This does not change your ongoing contract pricing." Send after posting? :email:

Carlos: Send after posting. BillingBot, queue credit memo CM-2026-09-99 for invoices AD-2026-09-15 and AD-2026-10-15 amount=5700 reason='onboarding rate misapplied; AE commitment'.1

BillingBot: queued credit memo CM-2026-09-99 (amount: $5,700) for invoices AD-2026-09-15, AD-2026-10-15. ETA: 24h to appear on customer account. Reference: #CM-2026-09-99.

Noah: Noted 1 I'll mark AR and flag month close for contra-revenue under 6510.

BillingBot: CM-2026-09-99 posted to customer account at 2026-10-02T10:33:25Z.

Marta: Confirmed posting and customer acknowledged. Closing DD-2026-881 and SR-9612. One-off adjustment; no contract change. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
